title: Port the remaining 49 console parity gaps to the Rust step definitions
description: Second and last batch of tools/parity/known_unimplemented_steps.txt: the issue write API, routing assignment editor, console now snapshot, browser viewport, page reload and in-progress issue fixture steps from features/console (issue_write_controls, agent_assignment_editing, agent_assignment_editor, agent_assignment, current_status_panel, board_horizontal_scroll, standup_panel) and the 31 in-progress issue fixtures in features/standup/standup_shared_stack.feature and features/agent/compaction_right_now_payload.feature. Implement them in rust/features/steps mirroring the Python steps, so the scenarios run under KANBUS_CUCUMBER_ONLY_CONSOLE=1 cargo test --test cucumber (and the default run for non-console ones), and empty the ratchet. Acceptance: tools/check_spec_parity.py exits 0 with zero tolerated steps; rust and rust-console-parity CI jobs green.
